title: fix: Detector order
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Rearrange detectors so that diagrams are properly detected.

Resolves flowchart-elk not being detected

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Diagrams with more specific detectors should come on top of the list. 

eg, when matching `flowchart-elk` from diagram text, if `flowchart` detector is checked before `flowchart-elk`'s detector, the diagram would incorrectly be detected as flowchart. 

So, we need to check `flowchart-elk` first. Same case with `-v2` diagrams.

comments.body:
I'd recommend adding a TypeScript function comment to https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/f3b313ec1d670bc426e1e0876fc61f154f577c48/packages/mermaid/src/diagram-api/detectType.ts#L52 too.

Something like:

```typescript
/**
 * Registers lazy-loaded diagrams to Mermaid.
 *
 * The diagram function is loaded asynchronously, so that diagrams are only loaded
 * if the diagram is detected.
 *
 * @remarks
 * Please note that the order of diagram detectors is important.
 * The first detector to return `true` is the diagram that will be loaded
 * and used, so put more specific detectors at the beginning!
 *
 * @param diagrams - Diagrams to lazy load, and their detectors, in order of importance.
 */
```

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Explicitly recommends adding a TypeScript JSDoc comment to a specific function, with a concrete example of what to add.
